label: Dei Filius ch. 4 and can
paraphrase: Dei Filius ch. 4 and can. IV.3: the sense of the sacred dogmas that holy Mother Church has once declared is to be retained perpetually, and one may not depart from it under the guise of a higher understanding; it is condemned to say that dogmas proposed by the Church may ever be given, with the progress of science, a sense other than the one the Church has understood and understands.
